title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The UK government has issued a formal response to the 2020 Committee report on artificial intelligence and public standards. It outlines its commitment to updating regulations, improving transparency, and ensuring AI technologies meet high ethical and safety standards for the public.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual outlines its strategy for regulating artificial intelligence in qualifications, aiming to safeguard assessment integrity and fairness. The guidance was issued at the request of key government ministers in education, science, and business.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This report examines how copyrighted material is used in training and operating AI systems, assessing legal implications and potential risks. It recommends safeguards, licensing guidelines, and best practices to balance innovation with copyright protection.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government replies to the House of Lords Select Committee’s report, “AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency,” by outlining its commitment to strengthen AI governance, safety, and innovation. It highlights plans for increased research funding, clearer regulatory frameworks, ethical guidelines, and public engagement to ensure AI benefits society while mitigating risks.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: This document sets out the purpose, tasks, and guidance for a committee that will examine how artificial intelligence aligns with public standards. It includes a list of frequently asked questions to help explain the committee’s responsibilities and the process for reviewing AI’s impact on public standards.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee’s inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence. The submission outlines the organisation’s perspectives and recommendations on how AI should be governed.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This policy explores how AI technologies will affect the regulation of medical products, focusing on the practical implementation of the Artificial Intelligence White Paper principles. It outlines guidelines and best practices to ensure that AI‑driven medical devices meet safety, efficacy, and ethical standards within the regulatory framework.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation the most effective, efficient, trusted, and influential in AI for its size. It outlines a vision and plan for achieving this through advanced technology, collaboration, and responsible, secure use of artificial intelligence.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: The Transport AI Action Plan outlines how the Department for Transport will partner with the transport sector to harness the benefits of artificial intelligence. It also addresses how to manage the risks associated with AI to ensure safe and responsible use.

title: Copyright and artificial intelligence: progress report
description: A progress report on the use of copyright works in the development of AI systems, under Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act.
summary: The report looks at how copyright‑protected works are used in training and developing AI systems under Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act. It outlines the progress that has been made, points out remaining challenges, and suggests steps to keep the process both legal and innovative.
